name: perdev
description: A local-first AI coding agent that runs on your own model.

commands.title: PerDev: Continue in New Chat (carry a summary)

perdev.baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL used for chat and the agent. Point it at any server that speaks /chat/completions (llama.cpp, Ollama at http://localhost:11434/v1, vLLM, LM Studio...).

perdev.apiKey.description: API key sent as a Bearer token. Local servers ignore it.

perdev.chatModel.description: Model used for chat and the agent.

perdev.autocomplete.backend.description: Server type for autocomplete: llama.cpp (/completion) or Ollama (/api/generate).

perdev.autocomplete.model.description: Autocomplete model name. Used to pick the fill-in-the-middle prompt format (qwen, deepseek, codestral, starcoder) and, for Ollama, which model to run.

perdev.server.autoStart.description: Start local llama.cpp servers for chat and autocomplete when VS Code opens, if they aren't already running.

perdev.server.chatModelPath.description: GGUF model file for chat and the agent. Point this at your own fine-tuned model later.

perdev.server.chatLoraPath.description: Optional LoRA adapter (GGUF) applied on top of the chat model, e.g. the perdev-lora-f16.gguf produced by training/perdev_finetune.ipynb.

perdev.server.autocompleteModelPath.description: GGUF base model file for autocomplete.

perdev.server.chatContext.description: Context window (tokens) for the chat server. Lower it if you run out of GPU memory.

perdev.server.device.description: llama.cpp device to run on (see llama-server --list-devices). Vulkan1 is the RTX 3070 on this PC; empty lets llama.cpp choose.

perdev.autocomplete.debounceMs.description: Delay after typing before asking for a completion.

perdev.agent.maxSteps.description: Maximum tool-call rounds per request before the agent stops.

perdev.agent.maxContextChars.description: Approximate conversation size (characters) before old tool output is trimmed. Keep it under the model's context window (~3.5 chars per token).

perdev.agent.suggestNewChatAt.description: When the chat uses this share of the context budget, offer to continue in a new chat that carries a handoff summary and links back to this one.

perdev.agent.approveEdits.description: Ask before writing or editing files.

perdev.dataDir.description: Folder where sessions and autocomplete feedback are logged as JSONL training data. Empty uses the extension's global storage folder.

perdev.logTrainingData.description: Log agent sessions and accepted completions for fine-tuning later. Data never leaves your machine.
